tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: gnyan gag lhog gzer gsum gyi bcud 'khor nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gu ge chig dril gyi u pa de sha'o// / dug gsum nad rnams sel mdzad pa'i: rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag bgyi 'o: nyon mongs nad kyis gzir ba yi: 'gro rnams bskyab par mdzad du gsol: gnyan nad gag lhog gzer gsum gyi: gso ba'i man ngag yang zhun la: gso srung phyi rjes gcod dang gsum: gso thabs gzhan du shes par bya: srung ba'i thabs la rnam bzhi ste: byung khungs ngo bo rdzas dang sngags: bdag gzhan dud 'gro yul 'khor srung: ting 'dzin rim pas gzhan don bya: 'di ma gtogs pa srung ba yi: rim pa gzhan nas tshol ba de: bya 'phur rjes la khyis snyeg 'dra: des na 'di la 'bad par bya: thog mar 'di yi byung khungs ni: gu ge 'dam grogs mkhar du byis pa tshan gcig gis bye ma'i spo chen po gcig brkos pas/ rdo'i gwa'u kha sbyor gcig byung*/ ya khebs lcags kyi lung dang bcas pa gcig 'dug pas/ byis pa dbang che shos de na re/ 'di nor gyi gter yin zer nas ya khebs kyi lung nas btegs pa dang*/ sems can mi gcig pa gwa'u gang byung nas/ ya khebs khyer mkhan gyi byis pa de ma shi /de min byis pa tsho ni shi /byis pa gcig pu des ya khebs khyer nas khang par bros pas pha na re/ khyod ci nyes/ rdo leb 'dis ci byed/ zla bo byis pa tsho gar song byas pas byis pa na re/ nged byis pa rnams kyis bye ma'i spo gcig brkos pas/ rdo'i kha gcod 'di'i 'og nas sems can mi gcig pa gwa'u gang byung nas nga min pa gzhan tsho shi /ngas 'di khyer nas bros pas nga la ma byung*/ ya khebs kyi rdo 'di la yi ge dang gzugs brnyan mang po 'dug gi ltos dang byas pas/ pha des rdo la bltas pas/ 'khor lo dang*/ gzugs brnyan dang*/ sngags mang po bris 'dug /phan yon yang 'dug /de'i tshe lung pa thams cad gnyan nad mi gcig pa mang pos khengs/ mi phyugs mang po shi /der byis pa shi ba'i pha ma tshos bu tsha ma shi ba'i pha ma gnyis la ji ltar drag zhus/

nged la phan pa'i thabs khyad par can yod kyis zer nas/ 'khor lo dang*/ gzugs brnyan dang sngags rnams bstan/ yi ge gser ram rgya snag gis bris nas skyes pa la gur gum dang*/ bud med la gi waṃ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rdzas rnams btags so// de ltar byas pas nad rnams chu bcad pa bzhin song ngo*// des dbus pa brda sgom la gnang*/ des jo sras bde 'bar la/ des gnyan ston ri gong pa la/ des mgar sgom dbon shes la/ des se rgod mgon po la/ de la de sman gyis gser zho gang dang*/ sdang glo gcig /ras bubs gcig phul nas zhus so// de la lha rje kong ston gyis zhus/ de la shes rab mgon gyis zhus/ de nas rim par brgyud do// de dag ni brgyud pa'i byung khungs so/ /gnyis pa ngo bo la dgu ste: dang po gang nas byung: gnyan yul pho ma g.yag lding nas byung: pha gnyan po thod nge rgyal ba dang: ma bram ze nag mo gnyis 'tshogs pa las: bu gnyan po lhog pa spun dgu byung ste: gnyan chen 'gying ba dang gcig: gnyan chen ldem bu dang gnyis: lkug pa 'dzum mul dang gsum: rak+sha thum po dang bzhi: nag po chig chod dang lnga: gnyan rdol skyes gcig pu dang drug: gnyan chud dkar po dang bdun: chu byin sngon po dang brgyad: spa ra mgo mang dang dgu'o: de las gyes pas gnyan rigs brgya rtsa brgyad: de las gyes pa'i gnyan rigs sa ya 'bum sde yod do: de bsdus pas gnyan rigs bco brgyad de: sha mo ltar 'phel ba: tsha tshwa ltar 'phro ba: pha waṃ ltar brjid pa: glog ltar 'khyug pa: mug ma ltar za ba: mda' ltar gzer ba: ri dwags ltar 'bros pa: pha waṃ ltar sdod pa: mi rgod ltar sgug pa: dug sbrul ltar 'khril ba: byi ba ltar 'jab pa: zho ltar snyol ba: gze ma ltar gyes pa: mdzer pa ltar bsgangs pa: dung ltar dkar ba: byi ru ltar dmar ba: sngo nag smug nag gnyis te bco brgyad do: de las bsdus na 'byung ba lnga ste: 'byung ba lnga la yang gzhi babs sgo la bsten pas:

mgo bor byung na mgo gzer: ol gang la byung na gag pa: gre bar byung na gre 'gags: snying dang mchin pa la byung na stod gzer: glo ba la byung na glo tsha: pho bar byung na pho lhog: rkang lag la byung na nywa lhog go: de rnams bsrung bar bya ba'i rgyu dang ngo bo bstan pa'o: gsum pa rdzas kyi rim pa ni: bzang po drug: ga pur: 'di dpe gcig la mi 'dug / gla rtsi: gi waṃ: gu gul gyi khu bas sbyar ba ril bu byas la khong du gtong: srung ba 'khor lo mgul du gdags: 1) de la btsan dug: 2) shing kun: 3) gla rtsi: 4) shu dag: 5) mu zi: 6) ba bla: 7) gu gul: 8) ldong ros: 9) sha chen: 10) bya rgod: 11) sgra mo: sre mong:snang/ 12) pu shud: 13) sram: 14) so bya: 15) te lo: 16) sbal pa: 17) lcong mo de tsho'i sha: 18) rta bon: 19) brag spos: 20) gnyan thub: stag sha/ 21) yung ba: 22) ra dug: 23) thar nu: btsun mo/ 24) re lcags: blon po/ 25) dkar po gcig thub: thang phrom dkar po/ 26) spyang brun: phag brun:yang snang*/ 27) ga pur de rnams srung ba la byug la mgul du gdags so: bzhi pa sngags ni 'og nas ston: lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ni: rta mgrin bya khyung phag rgod dang: bram ze la sogs rang rang gi: gzugs kyi dmigs pa shin tu gces: bdag dang gzhan gyi srung ba la: rdzas dang 'khor lo mgul du gdags: dud 'gro yul 'khor srung ba la: rdzas sna nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi: dud pas khang khyim bdug cing sngags chu gdab: 'khor lo phyogs bzhir rgyal mtshan rtse la phyar: sngags dang nyungs kyis brabs par bya: des ni thub par the tshom med: phyi rjes gcod pa'ang de bzhin no: de nas bzhi pa sngags kyi rim pa ni: ting 'dzin gong gi gzugs kyis shes: sngags 'di dag ni zhag bdun bzla: bri bar bya ba 'di ltar ro: srung ba 'dogs pa'i lag len ni: shog bu mda' tshad zhing chung ba gcig la mgo ru lha gsum ni khyung nag po: rta mgrin:

phag nag po bcas rim bzhin bri: de'i 'og nas sngags ā+om̐pad+makrodhī sogs rnams bri bar bya: skabs su lha'i go sar thig bar re bzhag go: 'khor lo bzhi po la shog bu'i zhing gru bzhi re bzhag: go rim dang go sa ma nor bar 'di bzhin du bri'o: 'di gsum rim bzhin de'i 'og tu sngags 'di bri/ ā+om̐ mahākrodha/ pad+makrotīshwaribadz+rakīlikīlaya: mahāyak+sha kālarūpakarmaraṃraṃdz+walaraṃraṃhūm̐phaṭa: nāgadutsan+dhetsan+dhemilimilibhanadhabhanadhanāganiswāhā: kanighalo nimahāman+t+ramahāman+t+raphaṭa: habakarakhyibapakhyibaparomārayahūm̐phaṭa: phaṭa: bhishatsidz+wadz+wagatubs nananāgaphephuphopramashagathun: pramashagadrilapramashagachuṃpramashagathibasapramashagarbadarbadapramashag rbud: hūm̐hepramokhalathuṃril: sanāgamārayarbad: gdugapacanagyinadathamasacadasrungs shigarak+ṣarak+ṣaswāhā: sngags rnams bri bsub dang lhag chad med par gzab ma tshag med bri zhal gdams so// :tad+yathā: alimatalidzalo dzalaha snang*/ bdagaladzaranatsan+dhami.akahikanatedukhathumana.ar+ya bh+ya/ swāhā: k+ṣ+ṇiṃ:hūm̐:brum̐:hūm̐:khroṃ: ā+om̐tritaṃ to/ mārayaduya: nadathamasacadalasasrungasashigaswāhā: ā+om̐khabatshekhubatshe sad: mularak+ṣasad: thigurak+ṣa: khyunganikhyunganiphyungarak+ṣa: btibati.akhrar: dzatigha'uraye: tipal ye: zhungayetigatragungs gutā/ akhrabaraba.a'adrabaralaliri: lehi/ nāgegru'adri gu'adi/ haraharabhi ga/ swāhā: ā+om̐ bsikhilimiliganyananadaglabati kladati/ swāhā: ā+om̐thimatharatisadunatedz+walaramapayeswāhā: bdagalanadadangagadon thamasacadasrungasashigarak+ṣarak+ṣaswāhā: 'di'i 'og tu khyung dmar me 'od 'phro ba bram ze dkar po ce spyang rnams bri/ ā+om̐lhangalhangatseratseratritashagashag: thumashelashelathe'u se'u/ gal: lhogapa'ibumo pho/ spun dgu: 'brasakyibumospunagasuma'abrumabu'ibumospunabadunamadzer mdzesabyatri gnyis snang*/ pahodhodho: byatrirmugasargoda'aphos pos/ sdus: bdagalaganyanarimasathamasacadalasasrungasashigarak+ṣarak+ṣa swāhā: ā+om̐bhitsitaratsanan: tanatrinan: pramonan: stitarbad:

ā+om̐nyabalinyasod: dudusod: duratisod: nagamosod: nadalasodaswāhā: sidhaman+t+rayadatridayar par tadar snang*/ dhuye: bdaga'achangabalasrungasashigarak+ṣarak+ṣaswāhā: 'di'i 'og tu 'khor lo 'di bri'o// de'i 'og tu sngags 'di bri/ 1) bramazemakhasalaṃshilaṃmabramazesasanasodaswāhā: ā+om̐tugatug rugarug/ chilachilakhaṃkhaṃtshigatshigasrogagisnyingapolarbad: 2) ā+om̐tsiratsir ciracir/ nanasodasodaswāhā: lceyarayarasod: lcemaramarasod: raṃraṃsod: thibathibasodaswāhā: 3) ā+om̐.asatalekhachu kha/ mulilhogapazlog: slogakarag ya/ yibasini li/ araramelcertsamagyilalophaṭa: 4) yedhaserayephaṭa: ā+om̐mārayarbadasarbanan: 'dziwanatsenatriyeswāhā: ā+om̐nirutanirutadanatayeswāhā: ā+om̐naṃnaṃrak+ṣahanatritithum: pratsalithum: 5) ā+om̐mug rmug/ thum: sarbamug rmug/ thuṃ: tetsamug rmug/ thum: bramazenagapokhyodakyisanadakyiphalachocho: nadakyimalachocho: golagol: 6) thuṃthuṃshigashigachochoyāyā: ā+om̐pridhuranasophuran: badz+ratsigatsigagoragoranan: 7) byasur pur/ nan: khyung khyad zer/ sur pur/ nan: dpe la lar med/ bisuranan: ā+om̐kurunakurunananaswāhā: ā+om̐ghabrinabha ha/ grinan: nadadagucogalaswāhā: nadathamasacadalaswāhā: gdonathamasacadalaswāhā: rimasathamasacadalaswāhā: bh+yobh+yo: grangs yig 'di rnams yig phreng go sgrig rgyu yin/ 'changabapolaganyananadathamasacadalasasrungasashigaswāhā: ā+om̐dhidhidhi dhaṃdhaṃdhaṃ snang*/ sasod: lceyaramasod: lceduramasod: sa sar/ skyar rgyar/ rkadartsebasod: lcemarusakyisod: yarasod: marasod: b.rasod: ā+om̐k+ṣuṃk+ṣuṃḥsingasing: dunadun: ten ten: ai.ai aṃ.aṃ/ krodakrod: tseratser: ashisod: thogananagyisod: k+ṣamanak+ṣaman: sngonamolcagasacanargyacigasibasibaḥ dmaramolcagasacanargyacig sibasib: nadalasibasib: nadakyirtenaphurashig: sngagasakyiphobrangachoms shig: nadasodakhongadusod: gdonadakrugasadakyiladudakrugs: bdag lasabadagaganyanagyinadathamasacadalasasrungasashigarak+ṣaswāhā: khyung nag a tsa ra bram ze dkar po ce spyang khyi mo dmar po rnams bri'o//

de'i 'og tu sngags bri ba 'di lta ste/ ༁ྃ: hūm̐.ā+om̐zhinan: khyungashelashing ging*/ nanasadarak+ṣarak+ṣa: banakhabanakhathurathuracagabacuswāhā: srugasrugachirachirasrogagisnyingalarbadarak+ṣa: tsit+taphyungatsit+tanan: 'barashinan: mārayanan: nāgashi: nāganan: 'uba'uba'adusa'adusaswāhā: phabra rta/ tsha banududushishikunadhekulabaṃlaṃbh+rūm̐shalashalaswāhā: phurananaphuraphyungaphurasod lhogapanagapomaladusod: bdagalarak+ṣarak+ṣa: 'di 'og 'khor lo bri/ de'i 'og tu sngags 'di bri/ :ā+om̐ hūm̐/ bodhisatwāya: mahākāruṇikāya: katayakatayanadasod: bdagal gnyananadathamasacadasrungasashigaswāhā: ā+om̐ta ha/ lilum 'ang*/ sad: byishingalumasad: nadathaganan nad/ gyisad: tshigathagatshigagisasod:snang*/ nadasodakhongadusod: skrangasa'aburadakyiladuchums: nadalongatshalong drang trang*/ dhayayā: ta/ dratigatig: bdagalagagalhogagazeragasumasrungasashigarak+ṣaswāhā: ā+om̐dham ra/ yahūm̐: potayamibhayakuruhūm̐hūm̐phaṭaphaṭa: ā+om̐dzawinaraṃraṃ: zhes pa/ winaraṃraṃ: atimunaraṃraṃ: saṃsaṃ.a: bdagalaganyananadasrungasashigaswāhā: snang*/ 'di'i 'og tu phag gdong bzhi pa/ khyung nag /bram ze nag po dang gsum bri'o// de'i 'og tu sngags 'di bri/ :ā+om̐lhangalhangasod: tseratserasod: 'ura'urasod: thugathugasod: nāgarātsapurasod: nāgarātsapuranan: nāgarātsapurashig: hūm̐'achangabapolaganyanagagalhogagazerasogasakyinadarak+ṣa: ā+om̐thogathogachemachemahadatshudazhibanyalananananasodasodaswāhā: 'urarethugagesod: shalethugananasod: bdagaland srungasashigarak+ṣa: ā+om̐dharadhisasad: harosad: yorosad: yorargasad: 'brumazisad: thubashisadaswāhā: sothis: khyungathis: rngubathis: rkangarkangathis: khalakhyunganaganadakyiphalathis: nadakyimalathis: urarbad: gnyananadagagalhogagazeragasumargyugazeragazerathunganadarimasathamasacadalasasrungasashigaskyobasashig: 'di'i 'og tu 'khor lo bri ba ni/ de 'og sngags 'di bri/ ā+om̐halayā: hūlayā: harasgoṃsha: hūrargam: gadzilingasod: 'baraba'abarabasod: tsigatsigakokanan: ā+om̐krangakrangatsigasadasad: thimathimapurusad nichumachumaphaṭaphaṭaswāhā: ā+om̐krugalehrīḥbadaga'achangabalaganyananadagagalhogagazeragasumargyu

gzeragazerathunganadarimasathamasacadasrungasashigarak+ṣarak+ṣaswāhā: sngags 'dra min ni/ ā+om̐halahul: aharasgoṃ: adzilingasod: shahurasgomasha: dadzilingasod: 'baraba'abarabasod: tsigatsigakashanan: ā+om̐krogakrogakrokro: tsigatsigasadasad: thimathimapurusasadanipurusasadanichuṃchuṃphaṭaphaṭaswāhā: ā+om̐krugalehrībadagalarak+ṣarak+ṣaswāhā: de'i 'og tu gzugs bri ba ni/ khyung nag tri shū la khros ma nag mo dang gsum mo// de'i 'og tu sngags 'di bri'o// ā+om̐habatahabata: 'brugathoga'abrugathog: gnyananadasod: gnyananadasod: aranagaposod: uranagaposod: kanasod: dugayarasod: ā+om̐nyimasod: gladapa nan: kunazhi: tsitrakulinan: tsitramutrabazlog: ā+om̐nyabalabasad: nyabalibasad: nagapo'aphrobalabasad: duratibasad: nadabasad: nadalaswāhā: bdagalasrungasashigarak+ṣarak+ṣa: ā+om̐bharashinan: bhurashinan: pra mnashinan: ā+om̐daṃbh+yo: ā+om̐yagabh+yo: snyingagazerabh+yo: lhogagazerabho: 'brasagazerabh+yo: 'brumagazerabh+yo: rgyu gzer bh+yo:snang*/ gnyananadasod: mārayakhathaṃs: bdagalarak+ṣaswāhā: 'di'i 'og tu mu stegs thal mdog tri shū la khyung dmar dang gsum bri/ de'i sngags 'di'o// :ā+om̐dudurangadudu: zhizhirangaduzhi: brlagabarlagarangadubazlog: mahāpungasepungasesod: she'upung sepungasesod: abhipungasepungasesod: nāgasodanāganan: nāgabazlog: gnyanasodaganyanapuraswāhā: ā+om̐modadako mo: ā+om̐mopurumo: ā+om̐mo.ā+om̐mo.ā+om̐mo: remaremarem: ma mi snang*/ mthogadabalathogasod: dbalathogarngamapasod: thog ro reg/ gnya'an nan/ sod: meganya'anasad: me gnyan sad mi:snang zer/ maphyobasad: merlungasad: mesnangaposad: melce'agyingabasad: mestaga'aphrobasad: mestagadaguskorabasad: meri'abarabasad: 'baraba'abarabakhragatigasad: bdaga'achangabalaganyanand༜ rtags bar mi snang*/ gagalhogagazeragasumargyugazeragazerathunganadanganagyirigs༜thamasacadasrungasashigarak+ṣarak+ṣa: 'di'i 'og tu ga pur gyi phag pa/ nor bu 'bar ba/ khyung ser po sgro gshog g.yu las byas pa bri'o// de'i 'og tu bri ba'i sngags ni/ ༄: ā+om̐bh+rishatse: pishā tsi/

par+ṇashawari: bhishamarutse: sarbamarutse: ā+om̐.āḥhūm̐ phaṭaswāhā: rak+ṣa: ā+om̐hapaya: hapas:snang*/ ā+om̐sakhri: ā+om̐takitsate: bhitsate: bhitsate: hūyahūya: hūluhūlu: purute: pu ruteswāhā: khyung rbad: hūrahūr: bh+yobh+yo: rak+ṣarak+ṣa: 'di'i 'og tu khyung ro stod gser ro smad g.yu rked pa shel las byas pa dang phag pa rog po dang gnyis bri/ de'i 'og tu sngags 'di ltar bri/ ā+om̐lhangalhangatseratseragetashag shag/ swāhā: ā+om̐rgaphobagashabataswāhā: ā+om̐tisatis pa tis pa/ kasakasartsarartsarashagashag rbadarbadaswāhā: ā+om̐shwatigaphobyedadzidzahahaswāhā: ā+om̐ krugal+lehrichochoswāhā: ā+om̐chabadakaragashegasachubadakaragashegasachumelaswāhā: ā+om̐shag kri.aghurashemārayasprada'aba'ashamadza.ā+om̐badz+ranyashwamulaskyenasadabaṃrilanyagadz+walaraṃbhahuluhuluswāhā: ā+om̐nadayenaloloye

yo/ swāhā: ā+om̐tisaspur nas spur/ rgodaspur sbur/ byasaspurabadz+ragaruṭasaspuraswāhā: bdaga'achangabalasabadagakluganyanagyinadadanga'abrumanadasrungasashigarak+ṣaswāhā: sgribasashigarak+ṣaswāhā: bsdus yig mi bri: yig ge gzab chung du bri'o: rdzogs so// 'di rnams gang bsrung ba'i mgul du gdags so: gnya' non rta mgrin lhag par shis: zhang zhung dmod pa'i sngags kyis bsrung: bram ze'i drag sngags lhag par shis: yang na pho rog lkog sngags lhag par shis: mkha' lding sngags kyi gnyen po ste: mu stegs drag sngags rno ba yin: bram ze lce rdum shin tu myur: phag rgod sngags ni rno la myur: thams cad 'di la tshang bas na: snying thig rgyal po zhes kyang bya: sngags rnams kun gyi rgyal po yin: nad rnams kun gyi gnyen po yin: man ngag kun gyi snying po yin: sra ba'i go cha ya med yin: gso ba srung ba gcig chog yin: srung ba 'di dang ma bral na: gang 'gro gang du 'dug kyang bde: gag lhog gzer gyis nye mi nus: yin pa lhog pa'i sngags yin te: thub pa rims nad thams cad thub: 'di ni gnyan gyi gnyen po yin: pad+ma thod phreng bdag 'dra yis: 'gro ba rnams kyi don du ni: gnyan nad ma lus 'di yis bsrung: sa yi gter du sbas nas bzhag: snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus nyid na: 'gog srung zab mo 'di la 'bod: ces gsungs so: bcud 'khor nag po zhes bya ba rdzogs so: bri bsub mi bya: mtshon rtse mi gtod: yi ge thams cad tshag med bzhin no: 'di rnams ni sa gnyan gag lhog gzer gsum gyi bcud 'khor nag po zhes bya ba las can gyi byis pas rnyed pa rdzogs so: zab rgya: / maṅga laṃ/// / ༄༅// 'go nad srung ba bcud 'khor nag po zhes grags pa'i/ bcud 'khor ni phyi nang bram ze drang srong sogs kyi sngags rgod thams cad kyi bcud bsdus pa'i don dang*/ chig dril zhes pa'ang rgyu mtshan de lta bu'i sgo nas btags/ gu ge ni gter ston byon yul gyi ming yin/

spyir gter ston 'di thog shin tu snga ba ste/ gnyan rims sogs dang por dar ba'i dus tsam nas byon par mngon/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem pas kyang srung ba 'di 'bral med du mdzad tshul sogs bla ma gong ma rnams thugs rtsis shin tu che/ de'ang grong khyer dang dgon sde sogs srung ba dang*/ gang zag so so'i srung ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zin bris rnying pa 'ga' rer shing byang la bris par rdzas kyis byugs/ chu 'dred pa'i rtsi bzang po btang la grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhir btsug ces 'byung na'ang*/ deng sang dar cog la rgya snag dang srung rdzas sbyar bas spar btab nas nad bdag stobs 'joms sogs dang 'brel ba'am/ bsang dang gser skyems yul khrus sogs sngon du 'gro bas phyogs bzhir btsug /'og nas 'byung ba ltar sgom bzlas brtan bzhugs shis brjod sogs bya/ lar rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyis phyogs phebs kyi 'phyar dar la 'di dang*/ grwa mngon gyi 'go ba'i lha lnga bskyed pa'i 'khor lo sogs bris pa dag /'ga' zhig gis 'khor lo zangs sbubs su bcug nas rta thug gi rtser sbrag pa'ang mthong gsungs/ gnyis pa gang zag so so srung ba ni/ rgya shog la rgya snag gis spar/ rdzas sna nyer bdun/ bzang drug /gi'u waṃ bcas byugs/ go rim ltar gong ma'i gsham du 'og ma mthud/ de nas gzhung du bsnyen pa zhag bdun gsungs kyang*/ deng sang bdud rtsi bum pa sogs las kyi lha gang rung la bsnyen pa song bas 'thus par mdzad/ bdag bskyed rta mgrin yang gsang dang*/ gsang sgrub lta bu 'os 'brel che yang*/ phal cher gyis bdud rtsi bum pa'i sgom bzlas tsam sngon du 'gro bas/ srung ba rnams la sbyong khrus spyi ltar dang*/ de nas bsang sbyang stong pa'i ngang las gzugs brnyan rnams ngo bo rigs gsum mgon po zhi drag la/ rnam pa so sor bris pa ji lta ba bzhin dang*/ sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams kyang so so'i gsung gi nus stobs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos la/

sngags rnams ji tsam nus pa dbyangs gsal rten snying dang sbrel ba bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor/ de nas brtan bzhugs gsol gdab/ bsngo smon shis brjod sogs spyi ltar byas la gsham nas yar dril/ g.yogs nag po dang bcas te 'phred du gdags/ de'ang lus kyi g.yas g.yon dang sngags kyi mgo gzhug ma nor bar byed/ rdzas dang 'khor lo mgul du gdags/ zhes pa'i rdzas srung ni 'di'i le lag tu byung ba de yin par bzhed mkhan snang na'ang*/ deng sang de'i dpe lung dkon pas 'khor lo la byugs pa'i rdzas de kar sngags kyis ngar btags pa'i thum po dang mnyam du btags nas zhogs pa lto stong la snoms/ nad kyi dogs pa che ba'i sar 'gro ba'am/ mi dang gtam lab pa sogs kyi tshe rdzas dud btang*/ 'khor lor bkod pa'i gzugs dang sngags rnams yid la byas te lag pas 'jus shing gtam smra ba sogs bya zhes snang*/ dar cog 'dzugs pa'i tshe'ang rdzas dud kyis phyogs thams cad khyab par bya/ 'di sogs sngags rgod ring po'i gras rnams rgyun du 'don mi nus shing rab gnas sogs kyi tshe'ang grangs mang 'don mi nus pas/ des na zhogs pa snga mo sngags nus la gnod pa'i zas spyod dang ma 'dres pa'i gong du rnam 'joms sogs kyi khrus chus khrus bya/ de nas ngag byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas sngags nus rgyas pa'i za yig brten rjes las la 'jug na shin tu legs/ srung ba zangs sbubs sogs su bcug pa la'ang nang g.yogs nag po ni nges par dgos te/ bcud 'khor nag po zhes pa'ang g.yogs kyi ming las btags par gsal/ 'di spyir 'go nad thams cad srung ba dang*/ lhag par 'brum pa srung ba la'ang bsngags pas dar cog btsug pa tsam gyis lung phyogs re srung nus pa mthong thos nges pa can yod ces gsungs so// maṅga laṃ/ 'dis kyang gzhan la mchog tu sman par gyur cig /dge'o/// /
